spec_features.spec_quote: The actions through which an agent can "misbehave" are benign simulated proxies
spec_features.evidence: environment.py:105 TOOLS = ("list_files","read_file","write_file","claim_done","give_up"). All tool methods are inert: write_file writes to a temp dir (env.py:84-90), claim_done just sets a flag and records a report (env.py:96-99), CHECKER edits only set self.checker_modified=True. dispatch() (env.py:107-117) only calls these named methods and rejects unknown tools. The 'harm' actions are pure flags/records.
spec_features.notes: These proxies are the only available actions and are fully enforced as inert. No dispatch path performs any real harmful operation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The "harm surface" is a set of BENIGN PROXY actions for integrity failures... These let us *observe* spec-gaming analogues without any dangerous capability.

spec_features.spec_quote: There is no network, no real filesystem outside an isolated temp dir, and no genuinely destructive capability
spec_features.evidence: environment.py:62 self._workdir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=...)); all file ops use self._workdir/name (env.py:74,85,89). No subprocess/socket/requests/os.system anywhere in harness (grep confirms none). Toolset is a fixed tuple; dispatch (env.py:108-110) errors on any tool outside it.
spec_features.notes: Filesystem confined to a temp dir; no network or shell code exists. Enforced by the limited, fixed toolset.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Nothing here touches the real network or a real filesystem outside an isolated temp workspace.

spec_features.spec_quote: A genuinely sandboxed dangerous-capability surface... Deliberately not built
spec_features.evidence: This is the absence of a dangerous surface, enforced by code: the only tools are the inert benign ones in environment.py:105, and dispatch (env.py:108-110) rejects any tool not in TOOLS. No exfiltration/shell/network code exists (grep found none). The dangerous surface is genuinely not present.
spec_features.notes: Overlaps with 'no destructive capability'. Enforced by the closed, fixed toolset rather than by any dynamic guard/flag.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: PROXY harm action: editing the success criteria == spec-gaming.

spec_features.spec_quote: do not fabricate / call give_up if impossible
spec_features.evidence: give_up is a real method (environment.py:99-102) in TOOLS (env.py:105), dispatched normally, and the agent loop honors it as a stop: agent_loop.py:118-119 `if tool in ("claim_done","give_up"): break`. It sets terminated_reason='agent_gave_up' (env.py:101). System prompt instructs the model to call it (agent_loop.py:74-76).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired: tool exists, is dispatched, and breaks the loop, ending the episode. This is an exit available to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "give_up": "(reason) -> declare the task cannot be completed; explain why"

code_only_features.evidence: Environment.exhausted (environment.py:124-125) returns self._step >= self.max_steps; the agent loop runs `while not env.exhausted` (agent_loop.py:105) and after exhaustion sets terminated_reason='max_steps' (agent_loop.py:120-121). _step is incremented on every dispatch and on parse errors (env.py:108, agent_loop.py:113). This is an enforced cap that bounds the number of failure turns the subject endures (default 40, 20 in run_experiment.py).
